 ## Хрюкает и убегает | Oinks and Runs Away                                                                                                                                                                    
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  A mod based on a popular Russian TikTok meme, making fun of old **Minecraft PE** add-ons where furniture was actually mobs in disguise.                                                                                              
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  **What does this mod do?**                                                                                                                                                                                                          

  - Blocks you place and find in the world might actually be mobs! ~~You can probably keep them as pets...~~ As it can happen to **any block**!
                                                                                                                                                                            
  **Placed Blocks:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  - 5% chance that any block you place spawns as a living mob instead                                                                                                                                                              
  - It runs away and makes animal sounds... And doesn't drop anything even if you kill it.                                                                                                                  
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  **Natural Blocks:**                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  - 3% of blocks in the world are secretly mobs                                                                                                                                                                              
  - When you hit an mob block, it squeals and shows damage particles                                                                                                                                                  
  - Hit it 5+ times and it will escape!                                                                                                                                        
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   
  **Animal Sounds:**  
 ```                                                                                                                                                                                                              
  ┌────────┬────────┬───────────┐                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  │‎ Animal‎ │‎ Chance‎ │‎‎ ‎ Special‎ ‎ │                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  │‎ Pig‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ │‎ 60%‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ │‎‎ —‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ │                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 
  │‎ Cow‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ │‎ 20%‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ │‎ —‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ │                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                
  │‎ Cat‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ │‎ 15%‎‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ │‎ —‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ │                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               
  │‎ Horse‎ ‎ ‎│‎ 5%‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ ‎ │‎ Rideable!‎ │                                                                                                                                                                                                  
  └────────┴────────┴───────────┘
   ```

   There's nothing useful this mods adds, and probably even ruins the game instead. But have fun!
